Bitcoin ETFs Stage A Major Reversal

U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs attracted $6.34 billion in net inflows during the third quarter, according to SoSoValue data, reversing approximately $5 billion in outflows during the second quarter. The buying arrived as Bitcoin gained 42.7% for the quarter, marking its strongest quarterly performance since the fourth quarter of 2024.
